units: Rs crore unless stated; per-share data after the 1:5 bonus of Sep-2023 (116.6 cr shares of Re 1).

profile.summary: India's second-largest paint company: decorative paints (emulsions, enamels, distempers, putty, wood coatings, construction chemicals and waterproofing) are ~80-82% of revenue; industrial coatings (protective - No.1 in India -, automotive, general industrial, powder) ~18%. Subsidiaries in India (STP, SBL Specialty Coatings, Berger Rock Paints 51%, Berger Hesse Wood Coatings 51%, Beepee Coatings) and abroad (BJN Nepal, Bolix S.A. Poland with UK/France units); two 49% JVs in industrial coatings (Berger Nippon Paint Automotive Coatings; Berger Becker Coatings) that are equity-accounted.
profile.marketShare: ~20% among listed paint companies (Q4FY26 deck; AR FY26 'nearing 20%'); company chart: FY22 18.9%, FY23 19.3%, FY24 19.5%, FY25 20.3%, Q1FY26 21.2% (5 listed companies, India operations). MD (5-Feb-2026): share 'was at 19.5, 19.6, it would have probably gone down to 19.4' in 9MFY26, lost mostly to Birla Opus.
profile.decoShare: Decorative ~80% of revenue (CRISIL 28-Aug-2026); industrial segment 'contributed 18% of consolidated sales' in FY26 (AR FY26 MD message); industrial 'almost 20%' (MD, 5-Aug-2026).
profile.reach: 64,475 dealers/distributors in FY26 (61,661 in FY25), 11,100+ added in FY26; 10,000+ tinting machines installed in FY26 (2,600+ in Q4FY26), 2,100+ in Q1FY27, aim ~10,000 again in FY27; ~1,900 exclusive stores (700 added in FY26; ~900 urban); 15 domestic paint factories (excl. subsidiaries), 30+ globally incl. subsidiaries/JVs; 207 warehouses and offices; 9,119 permanent employees
profile.rankings: 2nd-largest in India, 4th-largest paint company in Asia, 7th-largest decorative paint company globally (company); No.1 in protective coatings; 'fast growing No.3' in construction chemicals incl. STP (AR FY26)
profile.src: AR FY26 (pp. 4-8, 24-25, BRSR); Q4FY26 and Q1FY27 investor presentations; Q1FY27 call; CRISIL rating rationale 28-Aug-2026

q1fy27.notes: Deco value growth ~13.5% (highest in 12 quarters), operating profit ~+20%; protective, GI and powder grew less because price rises came late in the quarter; automotive double-digit value growth; Bolix flat (seasonal), STP disturbed by a plant issue; JVs (BNPA, Berger Becker) strong. subsRevenue = consolidated less standalone (GAM).
q1fy27.src: Q1FY27 investor presentation (5-Aug-2026) pp. 3-15; Q1FY27 call transcript (5-Aug-2026)

fy26.exceptionalNote: Labour Code charge Rs 53.29 cr (consolidated; Rs 49.99 cr standalone) in Q3FY26; Barasat (West Bengal) warehouse fire loss Rs 36.81 cr in Q1FY26, offset by an insurance claim receivable recognised in Q4FY26.
fy26.src: Q4FY26 investor presentation (12-May-2026) pp. 11-22; AR FY26 (MD message p. 25; notes 35, 52, 58, 60; board report)

standaloneHistorySrc: AR FY26, 'Financial Summary (Standalone) - Five Years at a Glance' (EBITDA there includes other income); Q4FY26 deck for FY25-26 PBDIT excl. other income
quarterlyStandaloneSrc: Quarterly investor presentations Q1FY25-Q1FY27 (standalone topline-performance and margin-trend slides; Q1FY27 deck pp. 5-6 for margins). Q1FY26 volume is the decorative figure ('mid single-digit', 5.6%).

guidance.said: Double-digit volume growth 'should happen'; the value-volume gap 'will remain in the extent of 4-5%' (said before the 2026 price rises)
guidance.outcome: Q4FY26 volume 11.8%, value 6.7%; gap reversed in Q1FY27 (volume 8.4%, value 12.7%) after price rises

guidance.said: Two plants (Panagarh, West Bengal; Odisha) 'together is an investment of about 1,800 to 2,000 crore', funded from cash; no buyback 'at this present'; only small acquisitions
Staggered price rises from March to support gross margin; operating margin within the guided 15-17%; competitive intensity 'expected to remain elevated'
Double-digit revenue growth to sustain; Q2 revenue growth 'slightly ahead' of Q1; Q2 volume 7.5-8%, price impact 7.5-8.5% (about 5% in Q1)
Operating margin 15-17%; Q2 margin up year on year as industrial price rises flow in; full-year expansion 'if it holds true at these prices'
Rs 600-800 cr for the year; the Panagarh project 'will start at the end of this fiscal'
guidance.outcome: FY26 capex Rs 518 cr (Screener cash flow)

guidance.said: A cut in H2 only if raw materials fall 'substantially, and there is peace'; 'very, very difficult to say'

guidanceSrc: Q3FY26 call (5-Feb-2026), Q4FY26 deck (12-May-2026), Q1FY27 call (5-Aug-2026)

competition.birlaOpus: Grasim's Birla Opus (launched 2024): Q1FY27 paints revenue Rs 1,661 cr, +64% YoY and +17% QoQ; 'third-largest organised decorative player'; 1,450+ franchise outlets; revenue market share up ~30bp QoQ (Grasim, Aug-2026)
competition.onBerger: MD (5-Feb-2026): Berger and Asian Paints both lost a little share, 'it has gone mostly to Birla'; other new players cut industry growth by '1-1 and a half percent'. MD (5-Aug-2026): the challenger raised its dealer price list, removing a ~5% gap; rebates to bigger dealers went up; '10% free material continues in most of the packs'; painter spends normalised; intensity 'reduced, but it still remains at an elevated level'
competition.jsw: JSW Paints bought 60.76% of Akzo Nobel India from AkzoNobel (completed Dec-2025; ~61.2% with the open offer); the company is now JSW Dulux
competition.investec: Investec (May-2026) upgraded Berger to Hold from Sell: 'peak competitive intensity may be over'; Birla Opus took ~3-4% share in two years, incremental gains seen at ~1.5-2%
competition.src: Q3FY26 and Q1FY27 calls; Grasim Q1FY27 press release (Aug-2026); Entrepreneur India / The Week (10-Dec-2025); Business Today (30-Jun-2026); Multibagg summary of broker views (15-May-2026)

rawMaterials.basket: Raw-material basket ~60% of sales, up ~20% in the West Asia conflict; cumulative retail price rises of 11-12% (Equirus, 13-May-2026). Petroleum derivatives are 55-60% of paint raw materials; industry price rises of 14-16% in Mar-Jun 2026 (ICICI Securities via Business Today, 30-Jun-2026). Dealer price list up 12-13% in stages, but realised price impact only ~5% in Q1FY27 and 7.5-8.5% expected in Q2 because of mix (MD, 5-Aug-2026).
rawMaterials.tio2: Withdrawal of anti-dumping duty on titanium dioxide helped Q4FY26 gross margin (Q4FY26 deck)
rawMaterials.backwardIntegration: All emulsions and most resins made in-house; thickeners started; a monomer bought from Dow to be made at Sandila (Lucknow) under a tie-up (MD, 5-Aug-2026)
rawMaterials.src: Equirus result review (13-May-2026); Business Today (30-Jun-2026); Q4FY26 deck; Q1FY27 call

capex.plants: New plants at Panagarh (West Bengal) and Khordha (Odisha): Rs 1,800-2,000 cr together, funded from internal accruals (AR FY26); Panagarh to start at the end of FY27 (management, 5-Aug-2026)
capex.crisil: Annual capex expected to rise to ~Rs 1,000 cr over the next few years for expansion and relocation of plants; no significant long-term debt addition (CRISIL, 28-Aug-2026)
capex.history: Screener cash-flow capex: FY22 Rs 774 cr, FY23 Rs 748 cr, FY24 Rs 275 cr, FY25 Rs 429 cr, FY26 Rs 518 cr
capex.src: AR FY26; Q1FY27 call; CRISIL 28-Aug-2026; Screener.in
